entries.topic: D172 OBPP v2 valid login still fails at isolated session activation due to existing Firebase UID ':' validator
facts: Owner tested signed OBPP v2 on device and reported 503 OBPP_SESSION_ACTIVATION_UNAVAILABLE after credentials accepted. This localizes the observed failure to Worker->InventoryCore /obpp1291/session/activate, not initial Firebase password validation.
